data_description.event_path: The event stream needs no device change. The webhook requires the device to send to Home Assistant.
data_description.hold_seconds: Devices only report the start of many detections; the sensor stays on this long after the last report.
data_description.playback: Recordings are H.265 or H.264. 'MP4 as recorded' starts at once, but browsers play H.265 only with hardware support. 'Convert to H.264' plays everywhere and needs a lot of CPU. 'Stream from the device' lets the device play the recording over RTSP.
data_description.recording_clock: The clock the device gives its recording times on. 'Automatic' finds it out. If the timeline and the recording played are off by your time zone's offset, choose the other clock.
data_description.stream_key: Used to decrypt recordings and local H.264 live video while keeping stream encryption enabled. Enter the device's verification code here to enable live decryption; audio and encrypted H.265 live video are not supported. Recordings can also use the code read from the device.
data_description.sidebar_panel: Applies to all devices and accounts of this integration. The dashboard card stays available.
data_description.panel_admin_only: Users without administrator rights no longer see the panel. Applies to all devices and accounts.
data_description.try_encrypted_stream: Try playing local RTSP live video even if the device reports Hik-Connect stream encryption as enabled. Many recorders only encrypt cloud streams, leaving local RTSP streams unencrypted.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.description: Notifications are accepted at {path} (local network only). Use the action 'Set notification host' or the device web interface to point the device there.

error.invalid_hold_seconds: Enter a value from 1 to 300 seconds.

user.title: Direct camera connection
user.description: Connect the camera on a recorder channel directly, with its own address and credentials. The live stream then comes from the camera, which also helps when the recorder's stream is encrypted.

data.reuse_recorder_credentials: Use the recorder's username and password

data_description.host: Address under which Home Assistant reaches the camera directly (for example in the recorder's PoE subnet, if routed).
data_description.rtsp_port: Empty: the port above if the host is the recorder's address (port forwarding of the recorder), otherwise 554.
data_description.stream_source: Recorder: the recorder's own stream of this channel, for when the camera's stream is not reachable. Settings, detections and snapshots still go to the camera.
data_description.reuse_recorder_credentials: Leave off if the camera has its own credentials.

locked_out.description: The device locked the login after failed attempts. The integration pauses for about {minutes} minutes and does not retry earlier.

channel_link_auth.description: The camera rejected the credentials of the direct connection. The recorder is used instead. Update the direct connection of this channel.

channel_link_mismatch.title: {device}: other camera on {channel}
channel_link_mismatch.description: The direct connection of this channel leads to a different camera than the one now connected to the recorder. It is not used until it is corrected.

init.title: Reporting linkage
init.description: The device detects {kind} but does not send it to the event stream, because the linkage 'Notify surveillance center' is off. Confirm to switch on only that linkage (trigger {trigger}); nothing else changes. {reason}

confirm.title: Enable reporting
confirm.description: The device detects {kind} but does not send it to the event stream, because the linkage 'Notify surveillance center' is off. Confirm to switch on only that linkage (trigger {trigger}); nothing else changes. {reason}

error.write_failed: The device did not accept the change.

abort.issue_ignored: Ignored. To show it again, open Repairs and choose 'Show ignored'.

area_missing.title: {device}: no area drawn for {kind} on {channel}
area_missing.description: The detection is on, but no line or area is drawn, so it cannot trigger. Draw it in the device web interface.

detection_off.title: {device}: {kind} is off on {channel}
detection_off.description: This detection is supported but switched off. Switch it on with its switch entity if you want to use it.

recorder_target_filter.title: {device}: {kind} on {channel} only for {detail}
recorder_target_filter.description: The recorder only reports this detection for the listed target types. Other movement will not trigger.

stream_encrypted.title: {device}: video stream encrypted by Hik-Connect
stream_encrypted.description: Stream encryption for Hik-Connect is on. Home Assistant cannot decode this stream; snapshots and events still work. Either switch off 'Stream encryption' in the device's platform access settings, or connect the affected cameras directly (direct camera connection).

default_password.title: {device}: weak or default password
default_password.description: The device reports that its password is weak or still the default. Change it on the device.

basic_over_http.title: {device}: password sent unprotected
basic_over_http.description: The device only accepts Basic authentication over HTTP, so the password travels in clear text. Enable Digest authentication or HTTPS on the device.

clock_skew.title: {device}: clock off by {detail} s
clock_skew.description: The device clock differs noticeably from Home Assistant. Event times are corrected, but recordings carry the wrong time. Configure NTP on the device.

live_decryption_failed.title: {device}: live video cannot be decrypted
live_decryption_failed.description: The device rejected the live stream login, offered only unencrypted Basic authentication, or the verification code does not fit the stream. Live video stays off to avoid a login lockout. Check the verification code in the options and the device's credentials, then reload the integration.
